acceptanceCriteria: A dispatch status or report output shows session counts and progress rates split by carryOver per role, covered by a test over a synthetic event log
The ATR spec records the view under a new numbered requirement
body: PR #1126 (V1-1782, ATR-V0-110..114) records carryOver and carryOverBytes on launched events and carryOver on finished events, but no command summarises them. GitHub #1122 asked to track whether carry-over sessions make progress more often. Expected: one status or report view compares no-progress rates of carry-over and non-carry-over sessions per role. Actual: the operator must read the event log fields by hand (an ATR-V0-113/114 non-goal).
title: Dispatch carry-over: report progress rate with versus without carry-over (residual of PR #1126)
